units.text: How do we know whether our working environment is truly ergonomic?
units.heard_small: How do we know whether our working environment is truly ergonomic?

units.text: Office workers spend hours in front of computers, often maintaining static postures that may lead to musculoskeletal discomfort and psychological strain.
units.heard_small: Office workers spend hours in front of computers, over-maintaining static postures that may lead to mystical skeletal discomfort and psychological strain.

units.text: Yet, ergonomic risks are not always visible at first glance.
units.heard_small: Yet ergonomic risks are not always feasible at first glance.

units.text: Poor working posture, prolonged static activities, and suboptimal workstation design can contribute to physical ergonomic risks.
units.heard_small: Poor working posture, prolonged static activities and sub-optimal workstation design can contribute to physical ergonomic risks.

units.text: At the same time, psychological factors, including perceived stress, may further influence workers' overall well-being.
units.heard_small: At the same time, psychological factors including perceived stress may further influence workers' overall well-being.

units.text: These interconnected dimensions highlight the need for a more comprehensive approach to ergonomic risk assessment.
units.heard_small: This interconnected dimension highlights the need for a more comprehensive approach to ergonomic risk assessment.

units.text: Conventional ergonomic assessments often evaluate physical posture and psychological conditions separately.
units.heard_small: Conventional ergonomic assessments often have valid physical posture and psychological conditions apparently.

units.text: Physical assessments may rely on manual observation, while psychological conditions are measured through self-report questionnaires.
units.heard_small: Physical assessment may rely on manual observation, while psychological conditions are measured through self-report questionnaires.

units.text: When these assessments are not integrated, the interaction between physical and psychological risks may be overlooked.
units.heard_small: When these assessments are not integrated, the interaction between physical and psychological risks may be overlooked.

units.text: We developed ERGO-AI DESK, an AI-assisted multidomain ergonomic assessment system for computer users.
units.heard_small: We developed Ergo AI desk, an AI assisted multidomain ergonomic assessment system for computer users.

units.text: It combines YOLOv11-based computer vision to assess body posture and workstation characteristics with brief self-report questionnaires covering ergonomic and psychosocial factors, including lighting, break habits, and perceived psychological strain.
units.heard_small: It combines YOLO-V11-based computer vision to assess body posture and workstation characteristics, with brief self-report questionnaires covering ergonomic and psychosocial factors, including lighting, break habits, and perceive psychological strain.

units.text: By integrating both assessments, the system generates ergonomic risk scores and targeted workplace improvement recommendations.
units.heard_small: By integrating both assessments, the system generates ergonomic risk scores and targeted workplace improvement recommendations.

units.text: Users capture their working posture using a camera, while YOLOv11 analyzes body keypoints and ergonomic indicators.
units.heard_small: Users captured their working posture using a camera, while YOLOv11 analyzed body key points and ergonomic indicators.

units.text: They then complete a brief questionnaire on workstation conditions, work habits, and psychological strain.
units.heard_small: They then complete a brief questionnaire and workstation conditions, work habits and psychological strain.

units.text: Both results are integrated into a dashboard displaying ergonomic risk scores and targeted improvement recommendations.
units.heard_small: Both results are integrated into a dashboard displaying ergonomic scores and targeted improvement recommendations.

units.text: ERGO-AI DESK aims to provide accessible and comprehensive ergonomic screening, with ongoing development and expert validation to improve assessment accuracy and support healthier, safer workplaces.
units.heard_small: Ergo AI desk aims to provide accessible and comprehensive ergonomic screening with ongoing development and expert validation to improve assessment accuracy and support healthier, safer workplaces.

units.text: ERGO-AI DESK integrates AI-based posture analysis and psychosocial assessment for multidomain ergonomic risk evaluation.
units.heard_small: Ergo AI desk integrates AI-based posture analysis and psychosocial assessment for multidominant ergonomic risk evaluation.

units.text: Smarter assessment, healthier workplaces. Thank you.
units.heard_small: Smarter assessment, healthier workplaces. Thank you.
